title: Dashboard Blank 7E0858179 3X1
author: Zimi0
description:
Hi.

This is a model for dashboard blanks for the VW T5.

I have found several other designs online but sadly they were either too brittle or wouldn't fit properly.

Thus I took out a blank and a caliper on my own and have created this model.

EDIT:

Sorry. I had Accidentally uploaded an old file with the wrong height. It should be fitting as seen in the photo now.

I printed in PETG. ASA or ABS would be better I guess, but since it's only a blank PETG will do.
